2783.title: Plugin CLI output mishandles a closed pipe
2783.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin CLI proxy writes to process output without a stream error listener, so a closed pipe emits an unhandled EPIPE event.

prReviews.verdict: ADDRESSES ROOT CAUSE; POLICY CLEANUP NEEDED
prReviews.topFinding: The fix handles EPIPE and preserves other errors, but its production change adds a normal code comment that repository rules forbid.

2783.proposedFix: Add a temporary stream error listener before each write, accept EPIPE as normal consumer completion, and keep other errors as failures.
2783.caveats: The direct test used a fixture plugin instead of a live Workflows run. It exercised the real CLI process and shared proxy. The review did not run the untrusted pull request branch.
